AstroFiles adds FITS and XISF loading and saving to Paint.NET.

This preview requires **Paint.NET 5.2 beta build 9772** (5.200.9772.9330).
Paint.NET 5.1 is incompatible. The package is built and tested on Windows x64.

Download the `AstroFiles-<version>.zip` asset, unblock it in Windows file
properties if necessary, and extract it. Close Paint.NET and copy the entire
`AstroFiles` folder into Paint.NET's `FileTypes` directory, then restart.
For Microsoft Store installations, use `Documents/paint.net App Files/FileTypes`.
Keep every DLL and the `.deps.json` file together.

The `.sha256` asset contains the ZIP checksum. See [README](https://github.com/Chuuei/pdn-astrofiles/blob/main/README.md)
for usage, metadata preservation limits, and installation details, and
[CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Chuuei/pdn-astrofiles/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for changes.
